VI.description: READ-ONLY probe of a running dialog's front panel\3A lists every control's label\2C class name and index. Written for Delacor's Create New DQMH Event.vi\2C whose controls have to be reached by NAME because {LV.Panel} offers no get-control-by-label method - measured\2C its method list has Replace\2C Traverse and Make Selection but nothing that resolves a label.\0A\0AWHY THE LABELS MATTER. Ctrl Val.Set and Ctrl Val.Get take a control NAME\2C so setting the dialog's text and numeric fields needs no reference at all. Two things do need one\3A reading a Ring's Strings And Values [] to learn which INDEX means which module\2C and firing OK through Value (Signaling)\2C which is the only way an Event Structure sees a programmatic write. Both need the control's position in Controls[]\2C and this probe is what supplies it.\0A\0ACONTROLS[] ORDER IS NOT ASSUMED TO BE ANYTHING. It is read and reported\2C never guessed - the same reason lvai_create_class warns that All Objects[] order is not stable across VIs.
